desc:
Freeride is a realistic MTB simulator built for riders. 🚲 Test your skills with fully functional bike suspensions across iconic locations, designed for both casual riding and technical lines. ✨

🔥 Game Features:
- 🚲 Collection of 20+ uniquely tuned bikes
- 📍 50+ diverse riding spots, iconic jumps, and specialized trails
- 🌀 30+ instant teleports for efficient map navigation

🏔️ Latest Update:
- 🗺️ Added the RedBull Trail location - A new freeride zone is now available in the game. The Red Bull Trail features steep sandy slopes, natural elevation drops, and wide lines!


🎮 Controls:
W - Forward (Hold for Backflip)
S - Backward (Hold for Frontflip)
A - Left
D - Right
SHIFT - Jump
R - Ragdoll
F - No Hand
T - Superman
G - No Foot

Join the game, choose your bike, and conquer the trails. 🚀 Leave a like and favorite to support future development updates! 👍
